messages.author: tom.reyes.000109@speltmoorfarmstead.example
messages.text: Welcome everyone to the new chapter space. We are setting up our first round of regional tastings for the spring.

messages.author: emily.calloway.101598@bluebarn.example
messages.text: The schedule for the regional conference is coming together nicely. I will have draft agendas ready for review by Friday.

messages.author: isabela.duarte.100490@lakemail.example
messages.text: In light of the recent health advisories, all in-person tastings for April are postponed. We are moving our upcoming milk quality seminars online.

messages.author: tom.reyes.000109@speltmoorfarmstead.example
messages.text: Thanks to everyone who joined the virtual grading session this morning. The recording will be posted on the main portal for those who missed it.

messages.author: isabela.duarte.100490@lakemail.example
messages.text: We are planning the spring virtual symposium. Let me know if your creamery wants to host a remote demonstration this year.

messages.author: emily.calloway.101598@bluebarn.example
messages.text: Members are asking if we will return to an in-person annual meeting next year. ICF staff is looking at venues in the Hudson Valley.

messages.author: tom.reyes.000109@speltmoorfarmstead.example
messages.text: It is great to have our regional competition back in person this fall. Entries are already coming in faster than last year.

messages.author: robert.brigham.101135@pinebarrowcheesemonger.example
messages.text: The retail buyers panel was a huge success last week. Thanks to Tom and Adriana for organizing the logistics.

messages.author: isabela.duarte.100490@lakemail.example
messages.text: We have booked the venue for the summer workshop series. Capacity will be slightly higher this time to accommodate the waitlist.

messages.author: emily.calloway.101598@bluebarn.example
messages.text: Sponsorship commitments for the annual gala are nearly locked in. We just need a few more volunteers for the registration desk.

messages.author: tom.reyes.000109@speltmoorfarmstead.example
messages.text: Demand for table space at the artisan cheese showcase is at an all-time high. Make sure your dues are current if you want a booth.

messages.author: isabela.duarte.100490@lakemail.example
messages.text: We are completely stretched for staffing on the committee side. I appreciate everyone stepping up to help judge the winter batches.

messages.author: tom.reyes.000109@speltmoorfarmstead.example
messages.text: With the recent cost inflation hitting small producers hard, ICF staff has introduced temporary hardship dues adjustments.

messages.author: laura.ludlow.101689@homestead.example
messages.text: If any members need guidance on succession planning or navigating facility closures, reach out to me offline so we can share resources.

messages.author: tom.reyes.000109@speltmoorfarmstead.example
messages.text: Input costs are finally stabilizing across the region. It is good to see some of our newer makers expanding their production lines.

messages.author: isabela.duarte.100490@lakemail.example
messages.text: We are holding a special session next month on the updated raw-milk aging rules. Several consultants will be there to walk through the compliance steps.

messages.author: emily.calloway.101598@bluebarn.example
messages.text: Traceability standards are the main topic of discussion for the autumn seminar. Let me know if your creamery wants to join the working group.

messages.author: tom.reyes.000109@speltmoorfarmstead.example
messages.text: Thanks to everyone for a productive year. We will wrap up our final chapter meeting of 2026 next month.
